rounds.planLine: PLAN: medium — Levin — Levin presses his ear against the egg in the hollow, eyes wide — a knock from inside the egg has been heard
PLAN: wide — Levin, Julian, Max, and Kiaan — all four press their hands onto the egg at once, none letting go — the four strangers are bound to the egg together

PLAN: wide — Levin, Max, and Kiaan — the three boys carry the bundled jacket-egg together down through a narrow lane of the Altstadt toward the last sunlit strip ahead — they have left the tree and are moving toward the Rathausbrücke
PLAN: close-up — Julian — Julian pulls the Marroni bag out of Levin's jacket and holds it to his mouth, cheeks full — the bag is now flat and cooling, the egg's warmth is threatened
PLAN: medium — Ramon and Levin — Ramon's hands grab at the egg in Levin's arms and the Marroni bag swings out of Julian's grip — the Marroni are gone into the Limmat and the egg has been seized

PLAN: medium — Levin, Kiaan, and Julian — the three press the bundled jacket between them on the dark stairs, Kiaan holding Julian's hand on the step — they are climbing at Julian's pace with only their bodies for warmth

PLAN: medium — Julian alone — Julian pushes autumn leaves apart between two thick linden roots and reaches toward something round and glowing with warmth beneath them — the warm egg exists and has been found

PLAN: wide — Levin, Max and Julian — Levin walks them back and forth between the root hollow and the Lindenhofbrunnen while the last sunlight slides off the fountain steps; Max stamps his feet — Levin's indecision has cost the warm sun; he is ashamed

PLAN: close-up — the crow — the crow drops from the branch with the red wool cap caught in its beak and flaps toward the hole in the Lindenhofbrunnen wall — the cap is gone into the fountain wall; the crow is the antagonist

PLAN: medium — Julian and Levin — Julian presses both hands around Lindi just lifted from the leaves, his face frightened; Levin leans close — Lindi is out of the heap but the hum has stopped and the shell is cold

PLAN: wide — Levin, Max, Kiaan, Julian and Nia — Levin holds Lindi pressed against his chest inside his open jacket; Max, Kiaan and Julian press their backs around him in a tight huddle with Nia planted in front — Lindi is back against warmth; the four boys and the dog form the living shelter

focus.planLine: PLAN: medium — Levin, Kiaan, and Julian — the three press the bundled jacket between them on the dark stairs, Kiaan holding Julian's hand on the step — they are climbing at Julian's pace with only their bodies for warmth
focus.pageText:
Die Treppe war schmal und dunkel. Levin trug das Bündel eng an der Brust, und die anderen drei drückten sich von allen Seiten dagegen. Vier warme Buben waren besser als einer, darum lief keiner voraus.

Die Stufen waren ungleich hoch, und Julian stolperte leicht. Kiaan nahm seine Hand und hielt sie fest. So stiegen sie langsam hinauf, Stufe für Stufe, in Julians Tempo.

fullData.imageSummary: Levin, a preschooler wearing only his white long-sleeve shirt, dark blue corduroy trousers, and brown boots, carries the tightly bundled red fleece jacket against his chest as the three boys climb the steep stone stairs of the narrow Altstadt lane. Kiaan, a preschooler in his orange pullover sweater, dark brown corduroy trousers, and blue boots, presses close beside him and holds Julian's hand on the step, while Julian, a toddler in his yellow quilted body warmer, mid-blue joggers, and grey sneakers, steps carefully up the dark stair. Medium shot in the cold autumn night, the three boys pressing close together around the bundle as they move slowly under the warm glow of street lanterns.
fullData.sceneIntent: Levin, Kiaan, and Julian climb the dark stone stairs together while keeping the bundled jacket pressed between them. Dark night with warm lantern light, weary but determined mood.
